name: Create Soil
body:
School conjuration (creation) [earth]; Level adept 1, druid 1, ranger 1, shaman 1, sorcerer/wizard 1, summoner

CASTING

Casting Time 1 minute
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect up to 1 cubic foot of soil/level
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell generates rich, arable soil appropriate for crops or other plants. The soil is loose and dry, weighing about 75 pounds per cubic foot.
